name: Delivery
description: Convert an accepted product definition into correct, reviewed, reversible, and shippable behavior.

members.role: Entry-only fallback — assume steering after primary leader provider/runtime failure; never implement
Default — clarify product intent and verify user-visible outcome
Default for user-facing work — resolve interaction decisions and review experience
Default implementation lane and peer reviewer for Engineer-B
Default implementation lane and peer reviewer for Engineer-A
Default independent behavioral and adversarial verification lane
Optional second independent evaluator for high-risk work

entry_criteria: An accepted PRD or bounded change contract has testable acceptance criteria
exit_criteria: Acceptance criteria and required review gates pass
rollback and residual risk are explicit
